---
title: "RFC 013: Dispatch Execution Phase"
subtitle: "Execution Loop with Retry Semantics"
date: 2026-01-19
---

## Executive Summary

This phase completes the dispatch execution loop from RFC 008 by adding a retry‑aware executor that processes files, records failures, and reports attempts. The loop uses a supplied processor callback so it remains testable without invoking the full pipeline.

## Implementation Scope

| Area | Deliverable | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Execution loop | `execute_dispatch_plan` | Retries pending files up to a max attempt count. |
| Result model | `DispatchResult` | Captures processed files, failures, and attempts. |
| Tests | Retry and failure cases | Validates loop semantics without pipeline execution. |

: Table 1. Dispatch execution deliverables.

## Code Changes

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/autoclean/utils/ingestion.py` | Added dispatch execution loop and result model. |

## Follow‑Up Work

## Appendix A: Behaviors

- The execution loop retries failed files until `max_attempts` is reached.
- Failures are returned for operator review without halting the loop.
